subject: How to annotate differential methylation events

messages.author: 21065eb57dfbc0bd
messages.subject: How to annotate differential methylation events
parts:
Hi,

In certain plants the annotation information about promoters is not available in the TXDB package in Bioconductor. Is there an easy way to work around with such datasets where only annotation information available is the gtf file.

regards

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Re: How to annotate differential methylation events
parts: some of them you can do with the package (piecharts), the rest is mostly basic R graphics. multi-histogram  is done with multhist from plotrix package. Figure 3 is just image() function run on a matrix that has different numbers for each category (hyper,hypo,none), barplots stitched to that later on via illustrator. figure 6 is mostly a result boxplot function, other stuff and annotation added later on using illustrator.
